CustomField.description: Formatted text representation of CurrentAmount with a leading dollar sign, thousands separators, and two decimal places (e.g. $1,250.00). Used by the FQS email templates to render currency cleanly in plain-text email — Salesforce classic email templates render Currency-typed merge fields as raw numbers, so this formula field is the merge target instead.
CustomField.formula: "$" & IF(CurrentAmount >= 1000, TEXT(FLOOR(CurrentAmount / 1000)) & "," & RIGHT("00" & TEXT(FLOOR(MOD(CurrentAmount, 1000))), 3), TEXT(FLOOR(CurrentAmount)) ) & "." & RIGHT("0" & TEXT(ROUND(MOD(CurrentAmount, 1) * 100, 0)), 2)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Formatted currency string used by the FQS email templates. Derived from Current Amount.
CustomField.label: Amount (Formatted)
